description.name: Basic Attack: Thornbreaker
description.desc:
Press  to activate:
Lindverne performs up to 4 consecutive attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold during the 4th attack to perform an extended slash against enemies.
When the heavy attack of the 4th attack hits an enemy with [Gash], consume all [Gash] stacks on the target, up to 3 stacks. For each [Gash] stack consumed, trigger [Maim] on the target once, dealing additional AoE Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
During the 3rd and 4th attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
